settings.storage.snapshotsFolderHint: Where version-history snapshots (ZIP archives) are stored.
settings.storage.safetyFolderHint: A safety copy of your save is taken here before every incoming sync, so a bad sync is always reversible.
settings.storage.autoDeleteHint: The snapshots OpenSave takes on its own — before a sync replaces files, when a game saves, at a conflict. Snapshots you took yourself are kept, and so is the newest one on every branch, whatever its age. Runs shortly after start and every few hours.
settings.storage.maxAuto: Automatic snapshots to keep per game
settings.storage.maxAutoHint: Default limit for newly tracked games (0 = keep everything). The oldest are pruned first, per branch. Change a single game's limit in its Configuration tab.
settings.storage.maxManual: Manual snapshots to keep per game
settings.storage.maxManualHint: Snapshots you take yourself have their own budget, so games that auto-save often (Elden Ring, Dragonsword) can't push them out. {forever}, which is the default.
settings.storage.applyLimits: Apply these limits to every game
settings.storage.applyLimitsHint: Replaces each game's own limits with these, then deletes the snapshots beyond them on every branch. To clean up with each game's own limits, use Space used above.
settings.storage.scanPathsHint: Scanning already checks Steam and common emulators — add custom libraries here.
settings.storage.excludePathsHint: Scans skip these folders and everything inside them — handy for stale save locations (like an old GSE saves directory) you don't want offered again.
settings.reset.title: Reset tracking
settings.reset.hint: Untrack every game at once, then scan again to add them back from the correct locations — useful after moving games between launchers or drives. This only clears the tracking list; your save snapshots on disk are kept.
settings.advanced.daemonPortHint: The port this device listens on, for the app and for your other devices on the network. Changing it requires a restart.
settings.advanced.pathTranslationHint: Rewrites another device's save paths to this one's conventions, e.g. "C:\Users\me\Saves" → "/home/deck/saves".
settings.support.title: Support OpenSave
settings.support.lede: Free and open source, and it stays that way — no accounts, no ads, no telemetry, and nothing locked behind a payment.
settings.support.body: It's built and maintained in spare time. If it's saved you the hassle of copying save folders between machines, you're welcome to chip in.
settings.support.point3: Time for fixes and new features
settings.support.openedToast: Opened in your browser — thank you.
settings.support.foot: Prefer not to donate? Reporting a bug or suggesting a feature helps just as much.
settings.support.note: Payment is handled entirely by Gumroad — OpenSave never sees your card details.
settings.sync.unknownGameHint: Tracking automatically works out a folder from where the game lives on the other device, which is why OpenSave usually needs no setup.

settings.sync.matchByAppIdMore: For example a Steam copy on one PC and a standalone copy on another. Leave this off if you deliberately keep two separate copies of the same game that shouldn't merge. You can always link games by hand from a game's page.

settings.sync.speedHint: Only applies to relay (internet) syncs — LAN is never throttled.
settings.sync.relayUrlHint: The relay that carries syncs across the internet. Join a room from {internetSync}.

settings.sync.relayPortHint: Forward this TCP port on your router so friends on the internet can reach you.
settings.sync.cloudBackupHint: Where backups go, whether every snapshot is sent there, and whether newer saves are brought from your other devices are all set on the Cloud Backup page.

protection.detail.direct: This device is reached straight over your local network, so nothing passes through a relay. Local traffic is not encrypted, so treat an untrusted network accordingly.
protection.detail.open: Saves sent to this device over the internet can be read by anyone holding your room code, including whoever runs the relay. Pairing over a relay did not keep an encryption key in older versions. Unpair and pair these two devices again to fix it.
protection.detail.pending: The key is in place. Encryption starts as soon as this device checks in, which usually takes a few seconds.
protection.detail.sealed: Saves sent to this device are sealed between the two of you. The relay — and anyone else holding your room code — passes them on without being able to read them.
protection.fingerprint: Pairing fingerprint {code} — it should read the same on the other device.

conflict.keepTheirsTitle.other: Deletes {n} files only this device has

conflict.hintAll: Nothing is lost whichever you pick. {both} (recommended) keeps playing yours — {peer} receives it too — and keeps {peer}'s version here on a branch you can switch to. {mine} makes your version the shared one — {peer} receives it (their old save is snapshotted first). {theirs} adopts {peer}'s version here, snapshotting yours first. Restore anything from the game's Snapshots / Branches tabs.
conflict.attentionBody: Its save changed here and on another device at once — choose which to keep.
conflict.attentionToast: Save conflict for “{name}” — choose which version to keep
conflict.applyingToast: Applying your choice for “{name}” — transferring {peer}'s files…
locConflict.title: “{root}” folder — {game}
locConflict.desc: This is one of {game}'s extra save folders, and it changed on both this device and {peer}. The game's main save is unaffected and keeps syncing; only this folder is waiting on you.
locConflict.attentionBody: Its “{root}” folder differs on both devices — choose which to keep.
locConflict.attentionToast: The “{root}” folder of “{game}” differs on both devices
locConflict.decideLaterTitle: Nothing of this folder syncs until you decide. Open the game to decide.
locConflict.hintUndo: A snapshot of every one of this game's folders is taken before either choice is applied, so both are undoable from the Snapshots tab. {mine} makes this device's copy the shared one and asks {peer} to take it — {peer} gets its own say if it has newer work. {theirs} brings their copy here.
locConflict.hintNoKeepBoth: There is no “keep both” for a folder: that option puts the other copy on a branch, and branches cover the whole game rather than one of its folders.

devices.trustTooltip: For your own devices: games it syncs go in the folder it names, even one this device doesn't recognise as a save, instead of waiting on Home for you.
devices.lanIntro: Devices running OpenSave on the same Wi-Fi/Ethernet discover each other automatically. No setup needed.
devices.noLanFound: No unpaired devices found on the local network. Make sure OpenSave is running on the other device.
devices.unpairConfirmBody: Unpair "{name}"? Their games stay on both devices; syncing between you stops.
devices.trustConfirmBody: Only do this for a device that is yours. When "{name}" syncs a game this device doesn't recognise, its saves go in the folder "{name}" names, instead of waiting on Home for you to choose one.
devices.repairConfirmTitle: Unpair, so you can pair again?
devices.repairConfirmBody: Unpair "{name}", then pair the two devices again so they exchange an encryption key. Their games and saves stay where they are. Nothing syncs between these two devices until you pair them again.
devices.repairedToast: Unpaired {name} — pair the two devices again to encrypt what you sync
devices.updateConfirmBody: {name} is running a newer OpenSave build ({version}). Download it from {name} and update this device? OpenSave restarts itself when done.

ui.copyWhatIsShownForA: Copy what is shown, for a bug report
ui.syncsSnapshotsAndAnythingThatNeeds: Syncs, snapshots and anything that needs your attention show up here.
ui.noWarningsOrErrorsAllQuiet: No warnings or errors — all quiet.
ui.leaveBlankToUseTheOpensave: Leave blank to use the OpenSave folder it creates
ui.onlyToKeepSnapshotsInA: Only to keep snapshots in a particular existing Drive folder — the ID is the long code in the folder's address.
ui.notSavedYetBackupsStillGo: Not saved yet — backups still go to the provider saved before.
ui.backUpEveryNewSnapshotTo: Back up every new snapshot to the cloud
ui.uploadsBeginOnceAProviderIs: Uploads begin once a provider is set up above. Snapshots are kept in an
ui.bringNewerSavesFromMyOther: Bring newer saves from my other devices
ui.whenAnotherDeviceSBackupCarries: When another device's backup carries on from the save this one has, and this one hasn't changed since, it's put in place without asking — the way syncing between your devices works. Anything else is asked about first, and this device's save is kept as a snapshot either way.
ui.everyGameWithSnapshotsInThe: Every game with snapshots in the cloud, as cover-art tiles — upload, restore, or delete per game.
ui.pickAnySavesOnThisMachine: Pick any saves on this machine — tracked or just detected — and export them with their locations into one file. Import adds them to snapshots, or fully restores them onto disk.
ui.syncsSnapshotsAndPlaySessionsShow: Syncs, snapshots and play sessions show up here as they happen.
ui.deleteFromTheCloudLocalSnapshots: Delete from the cloud (local snapshots are kept)
ui.noCloudSnapshotsForThisGame: No cloud snapshots for this game yet.
ui.deletingOnlyRemovesTheCloudCopy: Deleting only removes the cloud copy — snapshots on your devices stay.
ui.clickAGameToBrowseRestore: Click a game to browse, restore, delete, or upload its snapshots.
ui.lookingForSavesOnThisMachine: Looking for saves on this machine…
ui.listingTrackedGamesAndScanningFor: Listing tracked games and scanning for saves…
ui.detectedSavesExportFineWithoutBeing: Detected saves export fine without being tracked.
ui.eachSaveInTheFileIs: Each save in the file is added to its game's snapshot history. Nothing on disk changes — restore individual games whenever you choose. Games not tracked on this machine are reported in Activity and skipped.
ui.everySaveInTheFileIs: Every save in the file is written to its location on this machine — tracked games to their tracked folder, others to the path recorded in the backup. A safety copy of whatever is there now is taken first. Check Activity afterwards for exactly what was restored where.
ui.nothingIsEverOverwrittenWithoutA: Nothing is ever overwritten without a safety copy.
ui.waitingForYouToFinishSigning: Waiting for you to finish signing in…
ui.addressOrCodeFromTheBrowser: Address or code from the browser
ui.onedriveNeedsYourOwnAppRegistration: OneDrive needs your own app registration.
ui.goBackToOpensaveSBuilt: Go back to OpenSave's built-in credentials
ui.youReSignedInAlreadyChanging: You're signed in already — changing this disconnects you, because the existing sign-in belongs to the old app.
ui.theNumberInTheGameS: The number in the game's Steam store URL. Used to launch it and fetch its cover art.
ui.couldnTReachSteamToCheck: Couldn't reach Steam to check this number. If Steam's store or CDN is blocked on this network, cover art won't load here either — the ID itself may well be right.
ui.aBranchIsASeparateLine: A branch is a separate line of saves — a second playthrough, or a run you want to keep apart from your main one. You'll be asked what it starts from.
ui.switchingBranchesSnapshotsYourCurrent: Switching branches snapshots your current save first, then restores the other branch's latest state. A branch you just created has no state of its own yet, so it starts from whatever is in your save folder now — the two diverge from the first snapshot you take on it.
ui.snapshotsBackedUpToYourConfigured: Snapshots backed up to your configured cloud provider.
ui.newSnapshotsAreCopiedUpAs: New snapshots are copied up as they are taken. “Upload local snapshots” sends the ones from before.
ui.theFolderOpensaveTreatsAsThis: The folder OpenSave treats as this game's save.
ui.notSavedYetTheOldFolder: Not saved yet. The old folder keeps its files but stops syncing and being snapshotted.
ui.launchStartsThisEvenForA: Launch starts this, even for a Steam game. Leave it empty to launch through Steam.
ui.leaveBlankToAutoUseSteam: Leave blank to auto-use Steam art from the App ID. Paste any image URL for emulators.
ui.autoSyncSavesWhenChangesAre: Auto-sync saves when changes are detected
ui.snapshotsYouTookYourselfGetTheir: Snapshots you took yourself get their own budget, so a game that auto-saves often can't push them out.
ui.renameOnlyOnThisDeviceSyncing: Rename (only on this device; syncing is unaffected)
ui.showThisFolderInYourFile: Show this folder in your file manager
ui.someAreStillToComeFrom: Some are still to come from your other devices; this game syncs as usual once they're all here.
ui.yourOtherDevicesStillHaveTheirs: Your other devices still have theirs, and nothing is synced until you choose.
ui.putThemBackFromYourOther: Put them back from your other devices
ui.orIfYouMeantItDelete: — or, if you meant it, delete them there too; each device keeps a snapshot first.
ui.deleteThemOnMyOtherDevices: Delete them on my other devices too
ui.thisGameIsnTOnThis: This game isn't on this device.
ui.thisSaveFolderIsNotThere: This save folder is not there.
ui.itMayHaveBeenMovedOr: It may have been moved or deleted, or be on a drive that isn't connected. Nothing is snapshotted or synced for this game until it's back — OpenSave picks it up again within a minute. If the save lives somewhere else now, point the game at it with Edit.
ui.isThatWhereThisGameSaves: Is that where this game saves on this device? Only use it if it holds your current saves, not an old copy.
ui.ifThisGameIsTrackedUnder: If this game is tracked under a different name or drive on another PC (e.g. a Steam copy vs. a portable copy), link the copies so their saves sync across devices. Linking merges another tracked game here into this one: its save files stay where they are, and its snapshots move here, onto a branch named after it.
ui.nothingToLinkToTrackThe: Nothing to link to. Track the other copy on this device, or pair the device that has it and make sure it's online — its games appear here once it answers.
ui.aCopyOfMyCurrentSave: A copy of my current save
ui.eitherWayNothingIsLostSwitching: Either way nothing is lost. Switching between branches snapshots whatever is in your save folder first, and refuses to change anything if that snapshot can't be taken.
ui.someGamesKeepTheirSaveSplit: Some games keep their save split across more than one folder — the save data in one place, settings or mods in another. Add each extra folder here and it is synced, snapshotted and restored along with the main one.
ui.noFolderOnThisDeviceThis: no folder on this device — this location isn't being synced
ui.snapshotsAreCreatedAutomaticallyWhenY: Snapshots are created automatically when your save changes.
ui.someGamesKeepDeviceSpecificSettings: Some games keep device-specific settings in the same folder as the save, and copying those to another machine can break the game there. List them here and they stay put: never sent, never received, never deleted by a sync.
ui.thisGameSFoldersAreEmpty: This game's folders are empty, so there is nothing to pick yet.
ui.smallMovementsAsPagesDialogsAnd: Small movements as pages, dialogs and your library come into view, and as you point at a game.
ui.offForNowWhateverThisSays: Off for now whatever this says: Windows is asking apps to reduce motion.
ui.offTheArrowKeysScrollAs: Off — the arrow keys scroll as usual
ui.onNowAControllerWasUsed: On now — a controller was used, or this is a Steam Deck or handheld
ui.turnsOnWhenAControllerIs: Turns on when a controller is used, and on a Steam Deck or handheld
ui.theArrowKeysDoTheSame: The arrow keys do the same while it's on — a Steam Deck in desktop mode sends them for the D-pad.
ui.everySnapshotCheckedCanBeRestored: Every snapshot checked can be restored.
ui.snapshotsAreStillCheckedBeforeThey: Snapshots are still checked before they're restored.
ui.eachIsReadBackInFull: Each is read back in full and every file compared with its checksum. A snapshot is also checked before it is restored.
